narration.text: A self-administered employer's COBRA election notices go out inside their windows: a layoff, a resignation, an hours cut, a death, a divorce and a child's twenty-sixth birthday reported in time, and a separated spouse at her own address, while a waiver, a cut that kept coverage, a late or missing report and a leave are left alone. This is a chore for the HR and benefits manager of a 46-person manufacturer that administers its own group health plan. Athena works it across 3 portals: Crewmarrow HR, Carriercore and Postwren. On the bench, she found 7 of 7 eligible items, worth 770 dollars of the 770 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 11 traps, and she walked past 11. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 75 minutes, so she was about 39 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
